rationale: The round-1 revise finding describes superseded commit 735d87e; the bound revision 0d39e3167b26ea20ff1a0a36ff9adc3c10dbb5da already returns waiting (src/verificationRunner.ts:110,191) which the run loop re-evaluates as retry (src/runLoop.ts:720-722,2403,2443) and never runs a key unlocked while a live owner holds it, proven by the test that asserts status waiting with no command executed and the owner's lock untouched (test/verificationRunner.test.ts:223-233), alongside every earlier fix and passing check:fast and push-hook e2e.
